| RT-09 | `severity == info` | NOC | Slack #noc-low-priority | P3 |
| RT-10 | `service == billing` (any severity) | Billing SRE | PagerDuty + Slack #billing-alerts | P1/P2 per severity |

### 8.2 Notification Channels

| Channel | Purpose | Escalation Timeout | Notes |
|---------|---------|--------------------|-------|
| PagerDuty | Critical alerts, on-call escalation | 15 min (P1), 30 min (P2) | Must acknowledge within timeout |
| SMS (primary phone) | Critical alerts only | 15 min | Sent via Twilio; do not mute |
| Slack #payments-alerts | Warning and info, payments services | n/a | Thread replies expected within 1 hour |
| Slack #core-alerts | Warning and info, core services | n/a | Thread replies expected within 1 hour |
| Slack #noc-low-priority | Info alerts, all services | n/a | No action required unless escalated |
| Slack #billing-alerts | All billing service alerts | n/a | Billing SRE owns thread |
| Email sre-oncall@example.in | Audit trail, daily digest | n/a | Digest sent at 09:00 IST daily |

### 8.3 Escalation Paths

| Level | Role | Response Time | Notes |
|-------|------|---------------|-------|
| L1 | Primary on-call | 15 min | Must acknowledge and start investigation |
| L2 | Secondary on-call | 30 min | Escalated if primary unresponsive or needs help |
| L3 | SRE Lead (P. Nair) | 60 min | Escalated for critical incidents > 1 hour |

Escalation is automatic via PagerDuty if the L1 does not acknowledge within the timeout. Manual escalation is always permitted and encouraged when the situation warrants.

### 9.1 Standard Maintenance Window Definitions

Maintenance windows suppress alerts for planned work. All windows must be created at least 24 hours in advance, except emergency windows which require SRE Lead approval.
